subject: 老年女性修车师傅
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Authentic expressive charcoal and white chalk drawing on gray toned fibrous paper. An elderly woman bicycle mechanic in plain work clothes smiling beside a bicycle in a small workshop, half-body portrait, strong single window light, hands natural. Broad velvety charcoal blacks, erased highlights, smudged middle tones, sharp focal strokes at eyes and hands, visible paper tooth, loose unresolved peripheral edges. Entirely monochrome, no colored elements. Make compelling warm human character, not pretty anime. One standalone finished vertical illustration, no words or lettering, no collage.
assessment: 摄影式写实，颗粒和灰度突出

subject: 成年黑人女性鼓手
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Expressionist painted illustration: an energetic young adult Black woman drummer on stage, fully dressed in orange jacket and trousers, sticks lifted in a dynamic pose. Emotion drives visibly distorted angular perspective and forceful simplified anatomy, vivid cobalt blue against burning orange and magenta, jagged bold brushwork, compressed swirling stage setting, rhythmic forms echo sound. Powerful coherent face, deliberately expressive not photoreal. One independent vertical painting, no text no collage.
assessment: 强烈情绪配色与笔触，结构仍写实

subject: 成年男性吉他乐手
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Cubist-inspired illustration of an adult male musician with dark curly hair holding an acoustic guitar at a cafe table. Clearly intelligible character and guitar, face shown through integrated frontal and profile facets, forms broken into interlocking angular planes, overlapping viewpoints and fragmented tabletop, ochre charcoal sage and cream restrained palette, paper collage textures and flat painted shapes. Still warm playful and approachable for a beginner art book. Do not merely apply a polygon filter to realistic portrait. One independent vertical image, no writing no text no collage panels.
assessment: 正侧面并置直观，装饰几何较强

subject: 成年女性植物学家
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Surrealist narrative oil-painting illustration: a fully dressed adult woman botanist with auburn bob and teal coat calmly watering a tiny cloud growing from a terracotta flowerpot. Inside a serene greenhouse, enormous fish float outside high glass windows in a clear daytime sky; water droplets become miniature staircases in midair. Precisely painted coherent realistic anatomy and material textures, soft lucid light, impossible relationships rather than generic fantasy ornament. Dry witty mysterious atmosphere. One standalone vertical illustration, no text, no panels.
assessment: 写实外观与不可能关系

subject: 成年女性守灯人
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. A forceful black-and-white relief woodcut print style illustration of an adult woman lighthouse keeper in practical coat standing with a lantern on rocky shore in wind. Heroic approachable face, sculpted black silhouettes and vigorously carved white marks, directional hatching follows coat and wave forms, rough gouged lines, uneven ink pressure and cream paper showing through, absolutely two main values with no gray airbrushed gradients. Diagonal wave rhythm and bold negative spaces. One independent vertical artwork, no writing no collage.

subject: 成年女性书店店主
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Playful risograph editorial print illustration of an adult freckled red-haired woman bookseller with round glasses riding a cargo bicycle full of books down a leafy street, modest lilac blouse and rust trousers. No realistic gradients, no glossy 3D, no Ben-Day comic dot texture. One complete independent vertical illustration, no text or book titles, no panels.
